title: Night City - Midnight Ads [4K, sounds, music]
description:
Fully animated screenshot of an upcoming action RPG-game Cyberpunk 2077 from CD Projekt Red.
Included: street ambient sounds and exclusive short preview of Marcin Przybyłowicz's audio track as music ambience. You can change volume for yourself for each separately - sliders are present.

WARNING: this wallpaper demands a lot of RAM since it loads many objects on screen. If you have 16gb or more of RAM you're fine. If you're 1080p user, 4K won't be a problem for you as well.

Resolution: 3840x2160px


All rights belong to the CD Projekt.

This is a wallpaper of the "Dancing Polish Cow" meme also known as "Dancing Polish Cow at 4am". It has various effects and audio reactivity, as well as a short loop of the song [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qrxv0JNVtgY] "Cypis - Gdzie jest biały węgorz ?"[/url]

[hr][/hr] [h1]Features:[/h1] [i][list]
[*]The classic dancing cow
[*]Polish Cow soundtrack ([u][b]optional[/b][/u], turn music volume down on the wallpaper settings to use your own music)
[*]Audio reactivity
[*]Various effects to toggle on/off as you please
[*]Polski?
[*]Supports iCue/Chroma with supported devices LEDs reacting to bass.
[*]Custom background image/video. ([u][b]new[/b][/u])
(Cow can be hidden for a clean audio reactive custom background)  
[/list] 
[/i][hr][/hr]
